title: Filtered colimit of injective sheaves is Cech-acyclic on a quasi-compact basis
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space whose quasi-compact opens form a basis and whose pairwise intersections of quasi-compact opens are quasi-compact. Let $I$ be a directed set (nonempty, every two elements have a common upper bound), $(\mathcal I_i,\varphi_{i'i})_{i\le i'}$ a system of injective abelian sheaves on $X$ over $I$, and $\mathcal I=\varinjlim_i\mathcal I_i$ its colimit in abelian sheaves [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. For every quasi-compact open $U$ and every finite covering $\mathcal U=\{U_t\to U\}_{t\in T}$ of $U$ by quasi-compact opens with all finite intersections quasi-compact, the Cech cohomology [def-weil-pbc-site-cech-complex] satisfies $\check H^p(\mathcal U,\mathcal I)=0$ for all $p>0$. Hence $H^q(U,\mathcal I)=0$ for $q>0$, where $H^q(U,-)=R^q\Gamma(U,-)$ is cohomology over the object $U$ of the open site of $X$ [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] (for $U=X$ the cohomology of [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology]).

source.place: Lemma 01FF proof, the claim and Lemma 01EW (Cech vanishing on a basis)

proof.text: Prove compactness of all chosen intersections. In degree zero use W_zero. In degree p+1 the universal property identifies the chosen product with the intersection of the first open and the product for the tail tuple. Apply the pairwise compact-intersection hypothesis and induction.

The existing Lean signature indexes F by Discrete I, so its colimit is a coproduct rather than a directed colimit. Apply [lem-sc-compact-cech-cohomology-coproduct] in each degree to preserve this coproduct. Each summand has zero positive Cech cohomology by [lem-weil-pbc-site-injective-cech-acyclic]. A colimit of zero objects is zero (Mathlib IsColimit.isZero_pt), giving the first conjunct. The declared signature is kept unchanged.

For the compact basis take all finite compact-open coverings. At each point of a compact U refine the given covering open by a compact basis neighborhood; compactness chooses a finite subcover. This supplies cofinality, including the empty U. Chosen intersections are compact by the first step. Choose their SiteCechComplex by exists_of_covering. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-site-cech-vanishing-criterion] to the first conjunct. Transport the precoverage Grothendieck topology to the usual open topology using the Coverage and Pretopology comparison equalities.
